---
name: checked-in-reference
description: Writes a changelog entry for a merged change. Use when a change has been merged and the user asks for its changelog line.
---

# Changelog entry

1. Read the merged change and the issue it closes.
2. Write one entry under the version heading in `CHANGELOG.md`, for example
   "Fixed: the export keeps the last row".
3. Finish with the steps in [done.md](references/done.md).
